The '''Coruscant Rescue Ops''', also called '''Coruscant Emergency Services''', was an organization that existed only to serve the greater good of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], by providing disaster relief whenever necessary. They notably put out [[Fire/Legends|fires]] using [[Emergency firespeeder/Legends|emergency fire suppression speeders]].

==History==
[[File:CoruscantFireFighter.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Coruscant Rescue Op.]]
At the higher end of the Rescue Ops were Coruscant's fire-fighting teams; they piloted [[Emergency firespeeder/Legends|firespeeders]], wore fire and radiation-proof body suits (including bronze helmets), and were equipped with fire-suppression backpacks that fed handheld hose-guns. These teams protected the endless urban sprawl from disastrous fires and explosions.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Rescue Op members were drafted into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] and were often be found serving aboard Republic warships. During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Fire Team Three/Legends|Fire Team Three]] helped guide the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] down when it crashed into an abandoned industrial precinct while extinguishing the flames from the wrecked ship.

Although most of the Rescue Ops members were trained before the Clone Wars, after the war, many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] retired from service because of battlefield injuries, innate deterioration, or accelerated aging. Those troopers were reassigned to boost landing platform maintenance and emergency rapid reaction squads.
